entry.title: Above All: Introduction
entry.content:
Welcome to cjy’s blog!

Greetings! This first blog will serve as an introduction, mainly focusing on three topics:
Who am I, Why I choose to be a blogger, and What will I post
So read this blog first before moving on to other posts

About me

I’m Jiayi Chen(陈佳宜),born in 2007, currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in Artificial Intelligence at Shanghai Jiao Tong University (from 2025 to 2029). With a continuous aspiration to become a scientific researcher, my ideal is to achieve groundbreaking breakthroughs in the field of Artificial Intelligence, thus creating something that can really change people’s life.
Feel free to contact me
email: chenjiayi0505@sjtu.edu.cn

Why a blogger

The first time I was introduced to personal blog was when Nuoyan Chen (https://cny123222.github.io/) showed me Xiyuan Yang’s (https://xiyuanyang-code.github.io/) (both my seniors who offer me lots of helps with my school life). It doesn’t take long for me to understand how beneficial creating your own personal blog is. You can practise your expression skills, and more importantly, by transforming what you have learned into anoutput is an excellent way to better assimilate knowledge.
But creating my own blog wasn’t on my agenda until recently I faced a dilemma.
These days I have spent plenty of time reflecting on my life. After more than a month in SJTU, I found my school life totally different from what I had expected. My life is fulfilling, yet packed up with mathematical analysis and linear algebra (sometimes with cpp as well). I understand these subjects are foundamental to my further study in my major, but realizing the fact that I still know little about artificial intelligence is truly disturbing. The only chance for me to explore my major in the curriculum is the introductory course once a week, which offers a valuable horizon of the industry. However, this is far from enough. And I have to make it clear that it doesn’t mean that I do not have great materials for self-learning. To be honest, my Edge’s bookmarks are full of great courses and e-books recommended by my seniors and professors. It’s just that under the routined life filled with mathematics, I don’t know when to start, how to start, and where to start. But what I do know is that I need to start now, or I will nver start.
So why not start by creating my own blog?
I choose to start by creating my own blog, for I can take down my reflections on learning. I hope that this blog can serve as a “pusher”, which can push me to keep learning. There’s a lot I need to learn, machine learning, python and pytorch, Java etc. It takes time, then I will do it step by step.
